ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Patterns in Federal Funding Freezes
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and motivations behind federal funding freezes or terminations, potentially affecting multiple states or programs.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records investigation
questions: What other states or programs have been affected by federal funding freezes?
What are the motivations behind these actions?
ideas.insight: By analyzing data and public records, we may uncover a larger pattern of federal funding freezes or terminations, potentially revealing a systemic issue or abuse of power.
